svg.title: AREA 07
svg.desc: Use a gun on the high northern boulder in the dark room; the Force can collect the hidden boxes while the others head east. Break the boulder to uncover the switch and release the exit barrier. Pass through the false wall beyond the gate for shields and armor; four shields are needed in the next area.
